item.title: CarePortal launches in Marion County; aims to help vulnerable families
item.description: CarePortal is a service for vulnerable children and families to put in requests that would help them in times of need.

item.title: Restaurant Road Trip: The Weekend Bistro and Bar
item.description: Mall shopping can be a lot of fun, but also a little exhausting. But thanks to a new sit-down restaurant at the Meadowbrook Mall, shoppers of all ages can enjoy a little "weekend" R&R.

item.title: Marion County BOE outlines timeline for superintendent search
item.description: The Marion County Board of Education met to discuss the parameters of their search for a new superintendent and gave the public a timeline for their search.

item.title: Kyneddi Miller's mother sentenced in teen's death
item.description: The mother of a teenager found dead in an emaciated state has been sentenced after pleading guilty to death of a child by a parent, guardian or custodian.

item.title: Mon County property owners raise flooding concerns
item.description: Residents and property owners in the Dellslow and Richard communities of Monongalia County are again raising concerns about regular flooding in that area.

item.title: Preston County man found with fentanyl after multi-state police chase: Deputies
item.description: A Preston County man has been arrested and is facing charges after deputies say he fled from them across multiple state lines while in possession of fentanyl earlier this month.

item.title: West Virginia could sell its residents machine guns under new bill
item.description: Two West Virginia state senators have introduced a bill that would allow the state to sell automatic weapons to its citizens.

item.title: 'Drug kingpin' arrested in Fairmont for allegedly selling meth, fentanyl
item.description: A Maryland man accused of being a drug kingpin has been arrested and is facing charges after task force members say they uncovered bulk amounts of methamphetamine and fentanyl during a search in Fairmont.
